_comment: screen -> capture locale -> headline. '\n' is a hard line break; keep to two short lines. compose.py shrinks anything that would run past the canvas edge, so a long line costs size rather than getting cropped. Screen ids must match SCREENS_ALL in capture.sh. 'hero' is the exception: it is the opening slide rather than a captured screen, it sits on the dark panel with the wordmark, and three lines is right for it.
